# What is Django? - A high-level Python web framework that encourages rapid development and clean, pragmatic design.
# Django is a framework of python
# Why use Django?
# - ORM - Object Relational Mapper (Interacting with database using python code)
# - Admin Panel - Auto-generated admin interface for managing data
# - Security - Built-in protection against common web vulnerabilities
# - Scalability - Handles large amounts of traffic and data
# - Community - Large and active community with extensive documentation



# For using Django you must have python version above 3.7 or higher
# Install Django use command - pip install Django or pip3 install Django
# Check for installation - django-admin --version
# Install virtual environment - pip install virtualenv
# Create virtual environment - virtualenv myenv | python -m venv venv 

# Activate virtual environment - source myenv/bin/activate (mac) / myenv\Scripts\activate (windows)
# If error occours while scripting - (Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope CurrentUser -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned)
# pip install django


# Create Django Project
# Starting the project
# django-admin startproject myProject
# myProject is the project's name
# After running this command following folders and files are created:
# myProject/ (outer folder)
# ├── manage.py         # It is a command-line utility that lets you do administrative tasks.
# └── myProject/ (inner folder)
#     ├── __init__.py   # It is a file that tells Python that this directory is a Python package.
#     ├── settings.py   # It is a file that contains the settings of the project.
#     ├── urls.py       # It is a file that contains the URL patterns of the project.
#     ├── asgi.py       # It is a file that is used to run the project in ASGI mode.
#     └── wsgi.py       # It is a file that is used to run the project in WSGI mode.

# Run the project 
# cd myProject --> python manage.py runserver 8080
# Starting the app
# python3 manage.py startapp play
